Home.heroText: Bringing KSI Jamaats together to uplift lives, strengthen communities and shape a better tomorrow.
Home.storyP1: For nearly four decades, The Council of Gujarat has brought together Khoja Shia Ithna-Asheri Jamaats across the state with one shared belief: when communities stand together, meaningful progress becomes possible.
Home.storyP2: From education and housing to healthcare, welfare and disaster relief, our work is rooted in dignity, compassion and collective responsibility.
Home.workText: Every initiative starts with a simple purpose: making a meaningful difference where it's needed most.
Home.quote: An institution becomes meaningful when its work continues beyond the people who built it.
Home.quoteRole: Lifetime Chairman, The Council of Gujarat
Home.impactText: Beyond the numbers are families empowered, opportunities created and communities brought closer together.
Home.ctaText: Your support helps transform collective care into lasting impact.

About.title: A legacy of collective service.
About.description: Founded in June 1987, The Council of Gujarat unites Khoja Shia Ithna-Asheri Jamaats in a shared mission of welfare, dignity and progress.
About.whoP1: The Council of Gujarat (COG) is a community institution serving the Khoja Shia Ithna-Asheri Jamaats of Gujarat.
About.whoP2: Established in June 1987, COG was created with a clear purpose: to contribute to the welfare, development and wellbeing of the community, with particular attention to women and children and their physical, mental and educational development.
About.whoP3: Over the years, that purpose has grown into a broad programme of community service spanning education, higher education, housing, medical assistance, welfare, social development, group marriages and relief during times of hardship and natural calamity.
About.whoP4: Today, COG's work reaches across more than 100 cities and villages in Gujarat, bringing Jamaats, community leadership, volunteers, donors and well-wishers together around a shared responsibility: to serve our community and build a stronger future for the generations that follow.
About.mission: To strengthen the community through unity, service and sustained development, with dignity, responsibility and a commitment to future generations.
About.messageP1: Since its establishment in June 1987, The Council of Gujarat has carried a simple but enduring responsibility: to serve the community, strengthen our Jamaats and create opportunities for the generations to come.
About.messageP2: Our work has always been rooted in a belief that when a community stands together, its collective strength can become a force for meaningful change. As we look towards the future, our responsibility remains unchanged: to preserve what has been built, strengthen what is needed today, and create what will serve tomorrow.
About.messageBy: Nihalbhai Bhurani, President, The Council of Gujarat

About.networkText: COG brings together 44 KSI Jamaats across Gujarat, representing a community of more than 35,000 people. Since 1987, it has provided a platform through which Jamaats come together, share responsibility and respond collectively. COG's journey has also been connected with wider KSI institutional networks, including the India Federation.

Journey.title: Four decades of building, serving and evolving.
Journey.description: 1987–2027: from a shared commitment to collective responsibility to an institution serving communities across Gujarat.
Journey.rootsP1: The story of the Council of Gujarat did not begin in isolation in 1987. For years, the KSI community in Gujarat had recognised the need for collective action to respond to poverty, strengthen education, improve housing, support families in difficulty and create opportunities for a more secure future.
Journey.rootsP2: The archival record of the period before COG reflects a growing tradition of organised community development across Kutch and Kathiawad, including initiatives in housing, education, agriculture, employment, medical assistance, relief and group marriages.

m1979.title: The Gujarat Federation
m1979.text: The Gujarat Federation is established and plays an important role in an earlier phase of organised community development.

m1987.title: The Council of Gujarat is founded
m1987.text: In June 1987, The Council of Gujarat K.S.I. Jamaat is established: a Gujarat-wide institution dedicated to the upliftment of the community, with particular emphasis on the wellbeing of women and children.

m2001.title: Relief after the Gujarat earthquake
m2001.text: COG and the wider KSI network provide shelter, water, medicine and food, followed by temporary housing, income support and the rebuilding of permanent homes and community facilities.

mHousing.title: Housing at Talaja
mHousing.text: COG's housing work includes the Talaja 36-flat project. The modern Talaja development is publicly identified as Gulubhai Wadi.

m2027.title: Forty years of service
m2027.text: Four decades of institutional continuity, and a renewed commitment to preparing the next generation to serve.

Journey.timelineNote: The full illustrated timeline from the 40 Years catalogue will be added once COG shares the milestone details.
Journey.closing: What began as a commitment to collective responsibility grew, over the decades that followed, into an institution serving communities across Gujarat.
Journey.leadershipLink: Meet the leaders who carried it forward

Leadership.title: The people who carried the institution forward.
Leadership.description: Different generations. Different leaders. One continuing institution.
Leadership.intro: The Council of Gujarat has been guided by successive generations of community leaders. Each presidency has contributed to the institution's continuity, development and service to the KSI Jamaats of Gujarat.
Leadership.chairmanTagline: A life of leadership. A legacy of service.
Leadership.chairmanP1: He did not merely serve the Council; he helped shape the institution it became. Gulubhai Bhurani stands among the principal figures in the development and institutionalisation of modern COG.
Leadership.chairmanP2: His leadership was closely associated with the growth of the Council's housing and community-development work, its response during times of crisis, and its wider journey towards stronger collective institutions.

housing.title: Housing & community development
housing.text: His involvement in COG's housing work included the Talaja 36-flat project and the wider development of community infrastructure.

crisis.title: Leadership in crisis
crisis.text: During the 2001 Gujarat earthquake, Gulubhai served as President of COG and was part of the wider effort to coordinate relief, resettlement and rehabilitation.

institutions.title: Building collective institutions
institutions.text: He was directly involved in discussions with Dr. Asgar Moledina in Talaja that led towards a stronger India-wide KSI institutional framework.

lasting.title: A lasting legacy
lasting.text: The modern Talaja housing development is publicly identified as Gulubhai Wadi, carrying his name into a new generation of community development.

Leadership.termsTitle: 10 presidential terms. Four decades of continuity.
Leadership.termPending: Name and years to be confirmed
Leadership.termsNote: Names and years for each presidential term will be added once COG confirms them.

OurWork.title: Support that makes a difference.
OurWork.description: Education, housing, healthcare, welfare, group marriages and relief: the programmes at the heart of our mission.
OurWork.intro: Our work responds to the evolving needs of communities across Gujarat. Each programme represents a commitment to collective care.
OurWork.assistanceText: Members will be able to apply for education, housing, medical, widow and sports assistance online once the application system opens.

education.name: Education
education.short: School fee assistance and interest-free support for higher and professional education.
education.title: Every child deserves the opportunity to learn.
education.p1: Education is more than a pathway to a qualification. It is a foundation for dignity, independence and a stronger future.
education.p2: Since its early years, The Council of Gujarat has worked to ensure that financial circumstances do not prevent children and young people from pursuing education. From supporting school fees for students from families in need to enabling higher education through interest-free assistance, COG has sought to turn educational aspiration into opportunity.
education.quote: When we invest in a student's education, we invest not only in one individual, but in a family, a community and the generation that follows.

h1.title: School education
h1.text: Supporting the educational journey of students from families who may otherwise struggle to meet the cost of primary education.

h2.title: Higher education
h2.text: Providing interest-free higher education assistance to help deserving students pursue professional and specialised courses.

h3.title: Professional pathways
h3.text: Supporting students in fields including Medicine, Chartered Accountancy, Engineering, Diploma and Pharmacy, helping them move towards meaningful careers.

h4.title: Education as empowerment
h4.text: Creating opportunities through knowledge, because an educated generation is better equipped to strengthen its families and build a more prosperous future.

housing.name: Housing
housing.short: Helping families move towards safe, stable housing and stronger neighbourhoods.
housing.title: A home is more than four walls.
housing.p1: It is security. It is dignity. It is a place where families can build their future.
housing.p2: For decades, The Council of Gujarat has recognised housing as one of the fundamental needs of a secure and dignified community. From individual housing support to larger community housing projects, the objective has remained consistent: to turn the need for shelter into the possibility of a secure future.
housing.quote: 681 homeless families have been helped towards a home of their own.

h1.title: Community housing
h1.text: Larger housing projects such as the Talaja 36-flat project, now known as Gulubhai Wadi.

h2.title: A home to call their own
h2.text: Individual housing support that helps families move towards a safer and more stable place to live.

h3.title: Housing at scale
h3.text: Over the years, 681 homeless families have been helped through COG's housing initiatives.

h4.title: Looking ahead
h4.text: Continuing to treat secure housing as a foundation for dignity and family stability.

healthcare.name: Healthcare & welfare
healthcare.short: Medical assistance, support for higher treatment and welfare for vulnerable members.
healthcare.title: When health becomes a challenge, support should not be out of reach.
healthcare.p1: Healthcare is one of the most fundamental needs of any community. For families facing illness, disability, age-related vulnerability or financial difficulty, timely support can make a meaningful difference.
healthcare.p2: The Council of Gujarat helps families access medical care, supports higher treatment where required, and extends welfare assistance to vulnerable members of the community.
healthcare.quote: No member of our community should feel alone when they need help.

h1.title: Medical assistance
h1.text: Financial support in cases of emergency and special medical need, so that lack of funds does not become a barrier to essential treatment.

h2.title: Access to healthcare
h2.text: Supporting access to government healthcare initiatives, including an Ayushman Card camp for community members.

h3.title: Support for higher treatment
h3.text: Where serious conditions require specialised treatment, COG helps families manage the burden of care.

h4.title: Welfare for the vulnerable
h4.text: Annual financial assistance to elderly women in need across Gujarat. Around 700 sisters are supported through this initiative.

marriages.name: Group marriages
marriages.short: Strengthening families through group marriage programmes and social reform.
marriages.title: When families come together, communities grow stronger.
marriages.p1: Marriage is not only the beginning of a new family. It is the coming together of two families, a shared responsibility and the beginning of a new chapter.
marriages.p2: COG has supported group marriage programmes as an important part of its social development work, helping families celebrate marriages with dignity while reducing the financial and social pressures that can accompany the occasion.

h1.title: Group marriage programmes
h1.text: 43 group marriage programmes conducted in cooperation with donors from within India and abroad.

h2.title: Marriages
h2.text: 830 marriages conducted, helping young couples begin their married lives with community support.

h3.title: 1,660 families
h3.text: The programmes have involved 1,660 families, reflecting the wider community created around each marriage.

h4.title: Social reform
h4.text: Group marriages form part of COG's broader commitment to social reform, family welfare and community development.

relief.name: Relief & resilience
relief.short: Standing beside families through drought, natural calamity and recovery.
relief.eyebrow: STANDING TOGETHER IN TIMES OF NEED
relief.title: When difficult times come, community becomes strength.
relief.p1: Across Gujarat's history, communities have faced drought, natural calamities and devastating emergencies. In these moments, the responsibility of an institution is not simply to respond, but to stand beside families until they can rebuild their lives.
relief.p2: Relief has been an important part of the community-development journey connected with COG, combining immediate assistance with longer-term recovery and self-reliance.
relief.quote: From relief to recovery, from recovery to resilience.

h1.title: Responding to hardship
h1.text: During drought and severe hardship, community institutions mobilised assistance to help families through difficult circumstances.

h2.title: Relief in times of disaster
h2.text: After the 2001 Gujarat earthquake, the wider KSI network worked alongside COG to provide shelter, water, medicine and food.

h3.title: Rebuilding lives
h3.text: Relief was followed by temporary housing, income support and, later, the rebuilding of permanent housing and community facilities.

h4.title: Standing together
h4.text: Jamaats, community institutions, volunteers and supporters coming together when people needed them most.

Impact.description: Our impact is seen not only in the programmes we deliver, but in the lives and families we touch.
Impact.intro: For nearly four decades, The Council of Gujarat has worked to translate the needs of the community into practical programmes and lasting support.

NextGeneration.title: Rooted in faith. Ready for the future.
NextGeneration.description: The next forty years cannot be built by simply repeating the work of the last forty.
NextGeneration.intro: The needs of our community are changing. Young people are growing up in a digital world, artificial intelligence is reshaping education and employment, and community institutions must become more organised, responsive and accountable.
NextGeneration.focus: Our future must be rooted in faith, strengthened by knowledge, enabled by technology and guided by disciplined community institutions.

spiritual.title: Spiritual growth
spiritual.text: Strengthening the spiritual foundations of our community so that progress never comes at the cost of identity, with access to traditional Islamic education and stronger links between families, Jamaats and young people.

education.title: Core educational growth
education.text: Moving beyond financial help towards educational excellence: mentorship, career guidance, professional education and connecting students with professionals.

ai.title: AI & future education
ai.text: Equipping young people to lead in a changing world through AI literacy, digital skills, responsible use of technology and practical workshops.

identity.title: One community, one digital identity
identity.text: Supporting The World Federation's OneID: a verified profile linked to each member's Jamaat, helping Jamaats and Federations better understand and serve their membership.

governance.title: Discipline & governance
governance.text: Leadership that combines niyyat, taqwa, competence, accountability and service, with clear governance, standard procedures, financial discipline and succession planning.

institutions.title: Institutional strength
institutions.text: Jamaats that are organised, accountable, documented, connected and continuous, so that their strength never depends on a few individuals.

NextGeneration.visionIntro: By the next generation, we want a community that is:
NextGeneration.closing: Our ambition is not simply to serve the next generation. It is to prepare the next generation to serve.
